limitations: This demonstrates a specific compiled-copy/runtime path on C550 with MACA3.5.3.18 and mxcc6477545d4d; it is not a cross-GPU guarantee.
A trace descriptor flag is not a counter of compile operations; 72 of 1021 events in each trace omit the flag.
Zero files in the isolated binary-cache directory is not proof of zero compiler work anywhere.
The two first-launch host times are single instrumented observations, not independent replicated speedup estimates or pure JIT timings.
Only the copy function is annotated; other functions retain their own launch-bound behavior.
No semantics of the second launch_bounds argument or launches exceeding an explicit bound were tested.
No verified L2/DRAM counter or trace export time-unit calibration.
